# Rimelight Starter

> Welcome to the Rimelight Starter template. A modern, optimized, and SEO-compliant fullstack Astro framework built with Vanilla CSS and TypeScript.

## Core Content

- [Home Page](https://starter.rimelight.com/) - Home screen overview and features.
- [About Page](https://starter.rimelight.com/en/about) - Information about the template.
- [Blog](https://starter.rimelight.com/en/blog) - Documentation, news, and technical articles.
- [Docs](https://starter.rimelight.com/en/docs) - Complete guides on layout, components, and toolchain configurations.

## API & Metadata Endpoints

- [Sitemap](https://starter.rimelight.com/sitemap-index.xml) - Complete website index sitemap.
- [RSS Feed](https://starter.rimelight.com/rss.xml) - Localized XML publication feed.
- [API Catalog](https://starter.rimelight.com/.well-known/api-catalog) - Exposed machine-readable endpoint indexes.
- [LLMs Extended Index](https://starter.rimelight.com/llms-full.txt) - Full text content index for LLMs.
